Nina (Partnerships): Quick heads-up 12 NovaCompute + MarketHub listing goes live this Friday. Stratus SI asked to auto-claim marketplace leads for joint deals. Need a clear claim + credit rule before launch.

Rafael (Sales): Current baseline is 72h partner hold for vendor-marked leads. For joint announcements we usually extend to 7d so SI can engage. Proposal: if partner_tag=stratus -> co-assign for 7d. Else marketplace-only -> 48h then field SDR.

Priya (SI Ops): We need a referral_code field on the form. If referral_code present -> immediate auto-assign to Stratus and post to #si-intake. Also: if there's an existing CRM opp (any stage) for that account -> SI gets priority.

Tom (Product): Two product asks: 1) make the marketplace form optional opt-in for contact sharing (consent) so we don't leak contacts in press cycles; 2) include a redaction flag so PR list doesn't expose emails until partner agrees.

LeadRouter Bot: Draft routing rule created: `market-nova-stratus-v1`. Preview: https://staging.ops/redwood/rules/market-nova-stratus-v1. Scheduled deploy: Fri 08:00 UTC.

Nina (Partnerships): Also need tie-breaker: if SI and field both claim same account, field rep has 24h to perform first outreach (first-touch obligation). If field doesn't act in 24h -> ownership transfers to SI. Add SLA: joint demo should be scheduled within 5 business days of claim.

Rafael (Sales): Adding co-credit calc: split credit 60/40 (SI/Redwood) for marketplace-origin joint deals unless partner contract says otherwise. CRM tags needed: marketplace_source, partner_tag, referral_code, partner_owned.

Priya (SI Ops): Sample CSV for CRM import: 
```csv
account,email,marketplace_source,partner_tag,referral_code
Acme Inc,alice@acme.com,markethub,novacompute,STRATUS-REF-321
Beta LLC,bob@beta.com,markethub,,
```

Tom (Product): We'll add the redaction switch and consent checkbox. Product will queue a small change; ETA Wed EOD.

Priya (SI Ops): I'll test the webhook that posts to #si-intake and run a 48h smoke post-deploy to validate auto-assign rules. If disputes pop up during pilot, escalate to partnerships@redwood.com with routing rule id.

Nina (Partnerships): Action items: Priya 12 webhook & pilot; Rafael 12 CRM tag mapping + credit calc; Tom 12 redaction + consent. We'll reconvene Mon after post-deploy pilot results. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
